resources.string: Try an HTTP/HTTPS proxy when a WireGuard server does not respond on your network. Root TUN routing needs no Android VPN permission dialog or key icon. App routing also applies here.

Public third-party servers may be unreliable and can observe destinations. Plain HTTP proxies do not encrypt the proxy link: use HTTPS websites and apps. This mode supports TCP; ordinary UDP, including some calls and games, is blocked.
HTTPS proxy · TLS verified · TCP only
HTTP proxy · proxy link unencrypted · TCP only
